info.title: My App API
info.description: UPDATE THIS — describe your API. Each operationId below becomes an MCP tool callable by AI agents (workspace_<toolKey>_<operationId>).

servers.description: Canonical API base. MUST stay base-path-free: the platform's workspace-tool proxy prepends MOSES_BASE_PATH itself (CHAT-8qiu0). Paths below are relative to this base — the platform's openapi_parser folds servers[0].url + path into the registered endpoint path. Never list /health here (phantom tool) and never start a paths key with /api/ (double-prefix).
